name: Suno Bridge
desc: Standalone app that brings Suno stems into your DAW
desc_zh: 把 Suno 生成的分轨带进音乐制作软件的独立应用
solves: Moving from a Suno song into Ableton meant file juggling; Bridge sends generated stems straight into the project.
solves_zh: 以前把 Suno 歌曲搬进 Ableton 要来回倒文件；Bridge 能把生成的分轨直接送进工程。
best_for: You have a Suno sketch but the vocal needs your own mix; open Bridge inside Ableton Live and pull the stems.
best_for_zh: Suno 的小样想自己混人声；在 Ableton Live 里打开 Bridge，把分轨拉进时间线。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://suno.com/blog (post 'Suno Bridge: Your DAW, Suno-powered.')）。 Beta at launch, limited to Ableton Live 12 on Mac. No independent press source opened; the second source is Suno's own product page. 首次公开日期来源：https://suno.com/blog/introducing-bridge
